summary: Created a compact reference-only timeout and stall policy for long-running Codex/Flocky/OpenClaw tasks. The policy defines duration classes, progress and stall signals, allowed continuation behavior, retry rules, escalation triggers, status mapping, and a small operator decision record template while keeping AI-Orchestrator as the sole source of truth.
recommended_next_action: Use the policy as a manual operator decision layer when a task runs long, appears stalled, or asks for clarification, and escalate immediately on any safety or source-of-truth ambiguity.
